name: Article 3, § 1, point 2 – 93
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (2) ‘crisis’ means any ongoing or imminent disaster which has a cross sectoral impact which affects, or a cross sectoral potential impact which could affect, multiple sectors simultaneously or which constitutes a large-scale emergency without prejudice to the meaning of crisis in Article 2, point (22), of the Financial Regulation applicable in procurement procedures;
